CVE-2026-120423.title: undici vulnerable to Subresource Integrity bypass via whitespace in integrity metadata
CVE-2026-120423.description: undici is an HTTP client for Node.js. In versions 7.15.0 through 7.30.1 and 8.0.0 through 8.12.3, fetch verifies Subresource Integrity metadata by splitting the integrity string on a single space, but the SRI grammar separates metadata by ASCII whitespace, which also includes the horizontal tab. CVE-2026-13576.title: CallBackery versions before 0.62.0 for Perl store user passwords as unsalted HMAC-SHA1 hashes
CVE-2026-13576.description:
CallBackery versions before 0.62.0 for Perl store user passwords as unsalted HMAC-SHA1 hashes.

Passwords are hashed with hmac_sha1_sum() from Mojo::Util with no key, a single fast SHA-1 HMAC. There is no salt, so equal passwords give equal hashes, and no work factor slows down guessing.

An attacker who obtains the user table can recover passwords by fast offline guessing.

CVE-2026-99721.title: hwmon: (aquacomputer_d5next) reject short status reports
CVE-2026-99721.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

hwmon: (aquacomputer_d5next) reject short status reports

The HID raw_event callback runs before HID core validates the received
report length. aqc_raw_event() reads device-specific status fields at fixed
offsets, including multi-byte values, without first ensuring that the
received buffer contains every field. A truncated report can therefore
cause out-of-bounds reads and update hwmon state with unrelated data.

The required length differs between supported devices and cannot be
derived from the HID report descriptor. Define the minimum length needed
by each asynchronous status format, select it while configuring the
device, and reject reports that do not contain the last field accessed by
that format. Keep the published length zero until probe configuration is
complete, which also excludes legacy devices whose status is retrieved

CVE-2026-99754.title: scsi: target: Verify the iSCSI ISID is null-terminated
CVE-2026-99754.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

scsi: target: Verify the iSCSI ISID is null-terminated

iscsi_parse_pr_out_transport_id() returns the ISID of a FORMAT CODE 01b
TransportID as a pointer into the PERSISTENT RESERVE OUT parameter list,
lowercased in place and never null-terminated. spc4r37 Table 508 requires
the field to be null-terminated, but a non-conforming initiator can omit
the NULL; when the ISID ends at the end of the received buffer, the pointer
is not a C string.

The registration code still consumes it as one: strcmp() in
__core_scsi3_locate_pr_reg() and in the REGISTER AND MOVE path, and
snprintf("%s") in __core_scsi3_do_alloc_registration(), which also reads
its first 8 bytes unconditionally with get_unaligned_be64() - a NUL check
does not bound that read.
